div.div: حَصَفٌ Dry mange or scab: (S, K:) or small pustules, [like the small-pox, (see حَصِفَ,)] that generate matter, or thick purulent matter, and do not become large; sometimes coming forth in the soft parts of the belly in the days of heat. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
